title: Two rhenium compounds with benzimidazole ligands: synthesis and DNA interactions.
authors: Shtemenko, Nataliia; Galiana-Rosello, Cristina; Gil-Martinez, Ariadna; Blasco, Salvador; Gonzalez-Garcia, Jorge; Velichko, Helen; Holichenko, Oleksandr; Shtemenko, Olexandr; Garcia-Espana, Enrique
one_liner_zh: 该文研究铼配合物与G-四链体DNA的相互作用，含分子动力学模拟，但对象为小分子-DNA而非TF-DNA，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Two rhenium compounds: cis-tetrachlorotetrabenzimidazoldirhenium(iii) chloride - I and tetrabenzimidazoldioxorhenium(v) - II have been synthesized and characterized. X-ray data are presented for the new complex II. I and II show strong emission that has been used to investigate their interaction with several non-canonical DNA structures. Both compounds have a quenching effect on the fluorescence intensity upon addition of the investigated oligonucleotides; I was more selective for binding G4-than II. Association constant values obtained for I and II with G-quadruplexes reached 10(6) M(-1), which suggests a strong interaction between both complexes and these sequences. FRET-melting assays show that I and II have a rather high level of stabilization of ckit1 and ckit2 quadruplexes. I is toxic against macrophages RAW267.7 only in high concentrations, while complex II shows no toxicity against these cells. I and II accumulate inside cells in different degrees. Molecular dynamic simulation studies have provided insights into the binding modes of II with ckit1 and ckit2 G-quadruplexes. The results obtained show the DNA binding activity of the rhenium complexes and their ability to be players in the anti-cancer fight since they can bind to non-canonical DNA forms in oncogene promoters, accumulate in some cancer cells, and influence the cancer cells microenvironment.
abstract_zh: 合成了两种铼化合物：顺式-四氯四苯并咪唑二铼(III)氯化物 - I 和四苯并咪唑二氧铼(V) - II，并对其进行了表征。新配合物 II 的 X 射线数据已呈现。I 和 II 显示出强发射，已用于研究它们与几种非经典 DNA 结构的相互作用。两种化合物在加入所研究的寡核苷酸后，对荧光强度均有猝灭效应；I 对 G4- 的结合选择性高于 II。I 和 II 与 G-四链体 (G-quadruplexes) 的缔合常数达到 10(6) M(-1)，表明两种复合物与这些序列之间存在强相互作用。FRET-熔解实验显示，I 和 II 对 ckit1 和 ckit2 四链体具有相当高的稳定化水平。I 仅在高浓度下对巨噬细胞 RAW267.7 具有毒性，而复合物 II 对这些细胞无毒性。I 和 II 在细胞内的积累程度不同。分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟研究提供了 II 与 ckit1 和 ckit2 G-四链体结合模式的见解。所得结果表明，铼复合物具有 DNA 结合活性，并能通过与癌基因启动子中的非经典 DNA 形式结合、在某些癌细胞中积累以及影响癌细胞微环境，从而在抗癌斗争中发挥作用。
